title: Mean or worst shuffle for leaks
statement: Whether a leak gate for items served in shuffled order should judge the mean over many shuffles or the worst one is unsettled.
example: Judged by the mean, 31 ordering and 69 matching items that the worst case had excluded were restored, and none of the 31 solved exactly.
detail: A Grade 5 course's anti-leak gate moved from the worst case to the mean over resampled shuffles, because the platform randomises the presentation order on every attempt, so a student meets the distribution, while the worst case measures an attacker's luckiest presentation. Earlier, certifying on one seeded shuffle had shipped a leaky item and six more ordering items that a blind solver answered at 0.60 or above, one at exactly 1.000. The course's retrospective lists single-shuffle certification, and assuming worst-case and mean-case were interchangeable, among what failed, and the mean-metric evidence was among the claims its red-team records still disputed.
against: A rule on record judges a without-text check by the worst of several option orders (run-the-without-text-check-the-hard-way).

evidence.quote: the platform **randomizes the presentation order on every attempt**. A student cannot select the order; they face the distribution.

Their expected blind-solve performance is therefore the **mean over resampled shuffles**, not the worst case. Worst-case measures an attacker's luckiest presentation, which no student controls under `shuffle="true"`.

- Restored (borderline under worst-case, safe under mean): 31 sequence + 69 match. **0 of the 31 restored sequences exact-solve; mean 0.31–0.58; worst 0.33–0.75.** The high worst-case values are lucky single-shuffle hits the student never reliably sees.

anti-leak gate certified on ONE seeded shuffle, shipping a leaky certified_clean item (grade5 u1-l19-q09-sequence blind pair_acc≈0.75, resampled ~88% ≥0.6) and 6 more certified sequence items ≥0.60 blind including one at exactly 1.000
What failed: - single-shuffle certification for sequence items; - assuming worst-case and mean-case were interchangeable;
Active beads `B0154`, `B0155`, `B0156`, `B0157`, `B0160` challenge mean-metric evidence, gate arithmetic, expansion validity, construct validity, and 1241/0/0 certification.
